summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist per the spec. Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, standard library only); one explicit import line added to monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection with autofunction entry added to docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Nothing was committed. Tests, black, and flake8 were not run, per instructions. A static check found no line over 120 columns in the changed Python files, and the RST underline length matches its title. Choices beyond the spec: non-object top-level JSON and non-list data_list_key values raise ValueError; the loader does not check that image or label files exist on disk.
